summary: parseCadDocument remembers that an accepted sketch's geometry was valid, and that an accepted extrude or revolve found regions in its sketch, with the parameters of the document they were checked in. A later parse listing the same feature, for an extrude or revolve also the same sketch object, skips the check while the sketch's profiles and graph read the same parameter values. Results are kept only once the whole document is accepted and never for a failure; pockets and every other feature are checked as before. prepareCadEdits no longer checks the relations of an unchanged sketch whose geometry a parse found valid under the same values, since compiling the graph checks them. Drag previews at 4, 8 and 32 sketches prepare in 2.23 to 2.42, 2.18 to 2.38 and 2.36 to 2.52 ms, against 3.01 to 3.13, 3.61 to 3.69 and 8.07 to 8.38 ms with the 0.0.762 checks, and with an extrude after every sketch in 2.28 to 2.43, 2.29 to 2.96 and 2.65 to 3.43 ms against 3.19 to 3.54, 4.66 to 5.09 and 13.38 to 13.45 ms; one-sketch previews and the dependent drags are unchanged within noise. The drag preview benchmark gains the extruded workload.
warning: No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions, CAD files or controller output. Every document is accepted or rejected with the same error as before; a check is skipped only for the same frozen feature under the same values of the parameters its sketch reads.

checklist.schema: No UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, CAD schema, storage, journal or worker reply change. Post engine API remains 1 and saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event, cancellation or input-version behavior change. WebMCP tools keep their arguments and result fields.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change and no new application controls.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change. Saved CAD files are byte for byte the same.
checklist.verification: Tests count the geometry and region checks: skipped under the same values, run again for a changed value, a copied sketch or another sketch object, and nothing kept from a failed parse; a drag preview checks no relations of unchanged sketches. The accepted-feature corpus includes the extruded preview workload; of 1,568 parses reusing accepted features in a full suite run, 1,563 matched a full parse of a structured clone and the other 5 are the deliberate getter and proxy cases. Three bundled preview runs of 30 samples alternating with three of the 0.0.762 checks; the full Vitest suite, lint, ui:check, build, solver:check and the release check.

publicNotes.summary: Faster sketch drag previews in parts with many sketches and extrudes.
changes: Dragging sketch geometry no longer checks the unchanged sketches, extrudes and revolves of the part again while their parameters keep their values, so a preview in a part with many sketches responds about as fast as in a part with one.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions, CAD files and controller output are unchanged.
